caption:
Cable management is the interior design tip that costs the least and reads the most.

The eye reads every line in a room. A loose wire is a line you did not choose, and four of them turn a good wall into a busy one.

One channel from screen to sideboard, painted the wall colour. Ten minutes.

Save this for the weekend.
